needs.what: the melee keyword (702.121): a triggered ability 'whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat', grantable to other creatures via a static grant_keyword; underneath it needs a value counting the distinct opponents (players, plus controllers of attacked planeswalkers/battles per 702.121b) that any creature you control attacked in the current combat
needs.why_existing_wont_do: melee is not in keywords. A hand-written attacks trigger has no value for 'opponents you attacked this combat': attacked_this_turn counts which players attacked (raid), attackers_this_turn counts creatures, and player_count over {attacked_by: self} counts only seats this one creature attacked, this turn rather than this combat -- wrong whenever your creatures split across several opponents or there are two combats. Granting the trigger to other creatures would also need grant_ability of a self-referential attacks trigger, which a keyword would avoid.
